niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs and whether you want programmatic performance or brand reach. To help you choose, here’s a short guide plus concrete next steps.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies
- What are your campaign goals? (brand awareness, direct response, subscriptions, app installs, etc.)
- Budget range (monthly or total)?
- Geography (US, EMEA, APAC, specific markets)?
- Need full-service (strategy + creative + media buying + measurement) or only media buying/optimization?
- Do you want programmatic buying (DSPs) or direct buys on publisher platforms (Roku, Hulu, etc.)?
Answer those and I’ll shortlist agencies matched to your needs.

Where to look (top categories and examples)
- Global holding-company media agencies — best for scale, premium deals, cross-channel planning:
  - GroupM (Mindshare, Wavemaker)
  - Omnicom (OMD, PHD)
  - Publicis (Starcom, Zenith)
  - Dentsu (Carat)
  - IPG (UM, Initiative)

- Independent/ digital-first agencies — often more flexible, performance-driven, good for mid-market and fast tests:
  - Tinuiti (performance + CTV)
  - Horizon Media (strong CTV capabilities)
  - VaynerMedia (integrated creative + modern media)

- Ad tech/platform partners (not agencies but essential to execution/scale):
  - The Trade Desk (programmatic DSP, widely used for CTV)
  - Google DV360
  - Roku Ads, Amazon Ads, Samsung Ads (publisher/platform marketplaces)

- Creative, measurement & verification partners:
  - Innovid (creative & personalization for CTV)
  - Nielsen / Comscore (audience measurement)
  - DoubleVerify, Integral Ad Science (fraud and viewability)

How to evaluate agencies (practical criteria)
- CTV experience and case studies in your category/market
- Access to premium inventory and preferred deals (publisher partnerships)
- DSP/platform expertise and reporting/attribution capabilities
- Creative capabilities for 15–30s and dynamic/personalized CTV formats
- Measurement partners and ability to tie CTV to business outcomes (incremental lift, conversions)
- Transparency on fees, media markup, and data usage
- Willingness to run a small test campaign and share results

Questions to ask candidates (RFP starters)
1. Share two CTV campaigns similar to ours — objectives, approach, and outcomes (KPIs).
2. Which DSPs and publisher integrations will you use?
3. How do you measure CTV viewability, fraud, completion, and conversions?
4. What creative formats do you recommend and can you produce assets?
5. How do you handle frequency capping and audience targeting?
6. How will you attribute conversions to CTV vs other channels?
7. What are your fees and any media markups?
8. Can we run a 4–6 week pilot/test and what would that cost?

Recommended next step
Tell me your answers to the quick questions above (goals, budget, geography, full-service vs media-only). I’ll shortlist 3–5 agencies or partners that fit your situation and include why each is a good match.
